owner_report_2026_11_16.statement_summary: screenshot of the player showing 'Reading error · try again' on a title (5.8.1); optimise the app's performance as much as possible while keeping the effects.

root_cause.established: ReverbAudioProcessor (changed in 5.8.0) copied its input in bulk while the reverb was off; for an empty input Media3 passes its shared EMPTY_BUFFER, which replaceOutputBuffer(0) also returns as the output, and ByteBuffer.put threw IllegalArgumentException('The source buffer is this buffer') on the playback thread: ERROR_CODE_FAILED_RUNTIME_CHECK on every title, streamed or local, after every fallback
root_cause.how_found: AudioChainPlaybackTest (Robolectric, sdk 35) reproduced ERROR_CODE_FAILED_RUNTIME_CHECK with this stack before the fix and played to the end after it
root_cause.previous_diagnosis_corrected: 5.8.1 attributed the failure to R8 without proof; the failure is fully explained without R8 and was still present in 5.8.1, built without it. The release stays without R8 because no R8 build has run on a device

changes: the shared player state was copied every 3.5 s while playing to carry the position, recomposing AppRoot and every screen collecting it; it now changes only with the duration, and the session position is saved every 10 s while playing
Home's For you card read the position at its top while playing (five recompositions a second); it now reads it only while paused
the baseline profile now covers all of com.ketvoice.app (hot and post-startup), not only start-up packages
earlier in 5.8.1: page card transition read in the layer; lyrics index not rewritten for unchanged lyrics
